text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
And the finishing touch is to put in your<n>
favorites... Okay, done.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Carrot Ranger sausages and<n>Carrot
Ranger hamburger steaks!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's jam-packed with foods I love! I can't<n>wait to
dig in!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, tomorrow's picnic is going to be<n>so
exciting. All that's left is Akebono's...

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's the twelfth layer<n>complete. ...It
looks like this is still going<n>to take a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Flower and Biko, you should both turn in<n>for the
night! I'll go to bed when I'm<n>done with my
twenty-layer Buono Sumo<n>Stew lunchbox!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A true hero never abandons her friends!<n>And
remember—we're sprinters! Our<n>combined speed
should make short work<n>of this lunchbox!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If we divide up the tasks,<n>we'll be
able to finish quickly enough<n>that it won't affect
our schedule!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Thank you both!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Akebono, you just focus on cooking.<n>And don't
worry about how big things<n>get.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I can adjust the portions by arranging<n>the food,
and I'll divide up anything that<n>doesn't fit into the
boxes!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's cook up some buono food!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Biko, please pass Akebono the<n>ingredients she
asks for while making<n>sure the extra portions I set
aside find<n>their way into the fridge!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll move as quickly as<n>Carrot
Ranger Turbo in Speed Mode!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here we go! Pound some meat!<n>Crack the
pepper! Shake-shake-shake<n>the salt! ♪

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Stuff it into the boxes, wrap up the<n>extras
aaand... Here, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Carrot Boost full power! Yah, yah, yah,yah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the picnic arrives...

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
I think it's about time for lunch! I'm<n>starving after
all that walking.

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to you two, I completed the<n>upgraded
thirty-layer buono chanko<n>lunchbox! Go ahead
and eat your fill! ♪

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Here's your specially requested<n>Carrot
Ranger lunchbox, Biko.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Excellent! It's chow time! One, two...

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Dig iiiin! ♪
